description: This Java class models the <thread-pool> configuration element, defining thread pool parameters such as thread counts, polling intervals, and related settings for a server application.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing thread pool configuration, including thread limits, polling, and job management settings.

methods.name: getFailedRetryMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum retry delay for failed tasks.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Returns the queue size for jobs.

methods.name: getMaxThreads
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of threads.

methods.name: getMinThreads
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of threads.

methods.name: getPollDbMillis
methods.description: Returns the polling interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: getPurgeJobDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days to purge jobs.

methods.name: getRunFromPools
methods.description: Returns the list of run-from-pool configurations.

methods.name: getSendToPool
methods.description: Returns the target pool for sending tasks.

methods.name: getTtl
methods.description: Returns the thread idle time-to-live in milliseconds.
